subject: Confirming a short walkthrough — times to align stakeholders
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@acme-analytics.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Confirming a short walkthrough — times to align stakeholders

Hi Samira / Liam,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — appreciated the context on your scoring pipeline and the latency targets. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost per request while keeping p95 latency under 250ms for critical endpoints.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data flows, on-prem model hosting for a subset of workloads, and strict audit requirements.
- Next step you asked for: a short product walkthrough (30 minutes) to show the runtime, routing, and cost controls — we can keep it high-level with a brief tech call from Marissa.

To move this forward, could you confirm which of these 30-minute windows works best for your team (all times PT):
1) Mon 9/1, 10:00–10:30 PT — good for engineering + product
2) Mon 9/1, 13:00–13:30 PT — works if you want a stakeholder-friendly slot
3) Tue 9/2, 08:30–09:00 PT — earlier option to catch APAC attendees on the call

Proposed agenda (30m):
- 5m: quick introductions and priorities
- 15m: demo — serving runtime, routing, and cost/levers
- 5m: security/compliance Q&A (Marissa)
- 5m: next steps & mutual action items

If you prefer a different time, suggest two alternatives and we'll align. Also let me know who from your side will join (security, infra, product). I can add a one-pager after you pick a slot.

Cheers,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[dylan.brooks@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0198
